overview: Establishing polynomial convergence of Riemannian diffusion models (RSGM) via a discrete-time sampler with rejection sampling and early stopping, validated by measuring reset probabilities and TV distances on compact manifolds like spheres and tori.

modules.name: Manifold Geometry Foundation
modules.description: Defines the abstract base class for Riemannian manifolds and concrete implementations for the d-Sphere and d-Torus, providing primitives for the exponential map, logarithmic map, orthonormal frame lifting, geodesic distance, and volume measure.

modules.name: Target Distribution Construction
modules.description: Implements the generation of training data by constructing Warped Gaussian Mixtures on the manifold, specifically handling the push-forward operation from Euclidean space to the manifold via the universal covering map.

modules.name: Riemannian Score Network
modules.description: Implements the neural network architecture for estimating the score function on the tangent space of the manifold, mapping manifold coordinates and diffusion time to a tangent vector (score).

modules.name: Riemannian Forward Process
modules.description: Simulates the Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) on the manifold to generate noisy samples from the data distribution for training the score network, utilizing the defined orthonormal frames and stochastic integration.

modules.name: Score Matching Training
modules.description: Executes the training loop for the score network using denoising score matching objectives on the manifold, managing the optimization process to achieve the L2-accurate score estimates assumed in the convergence proof.

modules.name: RSGM Sampling Algorithm
modules.description: Implements the discrete-time reverse process (Algorithm 1) for generating samples, including the tangent update calculation, Gaussian noise lifting to tangent space, and the rejection sampling step based on the injectivity radius bound.

modules.name: Manifold Density Estimation
modules.description: Implements a Kernel Density Estimator (KDE) adapted for Riemannian manifolds to approximate the probability density function of generated samples, necessary for computing the Total Variation distance.

modules.name: Convergence Metrics Evaluation
modules.description: Calculates the key evaluation metrics for the diffusion process: the Total Variation (TV) distance between generated and target distributions, and the Reset Probability (exit probability) of the rejection sampling step.

modules.name: Experiment: Reset Probability Analysis
modules.description: Orchestrates the experiments to validate the exponential decay of the reset probability with respect to the inverse square root of step size (Figure 1), running the reverse process across varying stepsizes on S2 and Td.

modules.name: Experiment: TV Convergence Analysis
modules.description: Orchestrates the experiments to validate the TV accuracy convergence with respect to the number of reverse steps (Figure 2), testing the sampling quality across different dimensions of the torus Td using the warped Gaussian mixture target.
